entries.speaker: Palace Infiltration Deadline
entries.en: If you cannot execute the plan by the deadline,[n]then it's [clr 2]game over[clr 27]. Keep vigilant and be aware[n]of the time remaining.

entries.speaker: Palace Infiltration Deadline
entries.en: Palaces contain many strong enemies. Consult[n]with your allies and make use of the various[n][clr 2]facilities in the city[clr 27] to ensure a successful[n]infiltration.
